description.value: Hanks is a small, independently operated restaurant on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria, built around an ever-changing menu sourced directly from local farmers and fishers. The kitchen leans into flavour combinations you don't typically encounter, served in a casual, deliberately loud setting. A touring cyclist rolling into the city centre would find a neighbourhood spot with a strong local identity and a rotating selection of ingredient-driven dishes.
